# 2 Baruch Chapter 33 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** And when I had spoken all these words to the people, I went away and sat in a cave of the earth in the valley of Kidron, and I fasted there for seven days.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering. A single transitional verse concluding the second fast and dialogue section. Baruch returns to the Kidron valley cave for a third fast, which will yield the cedar-forest vision in ch. 36.*
